_comment: Canonical L3 approval wire shapes. ApprovalCompletedEvent is the SSE event payload emitted when a user completes the WebAuthn approval ceremony. SuspendedTransaction represents a transaction awaiting L3 human approval. ApprovalProof holds all fields needed to record an L3 approval. Serialized from ApprovalCompletedEvent (internal/models/approval.go), SuspendedTransaction and ApprovalProof (internal/models/suspended.go).

approval_completed_event._description: SSE event payload for L3 transaction approval completion. Emitted by the gateway when a user completes the WebAuthn approval ceremony.

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the approved transaction

suspended_transaction._description: A transaction awaiting L3 human approval. Stored in the suspended transactions store.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that triggered the suspension

user_id.description: User ID that initiated the transaction

operator_id.description: Operator ID that submitted the transaction

approved.description: Whether the transaction has been approved

approved_at.description: When the transaction was approved. Omitted when not approved.

approved_by.description: CLI session ID or user ID of the approver. Omitted when not approved.

approval_signature.description: Signature over transaction_hash by the approver. Omitted when not approved.

expected_cert_fingerprint.description: Expected mTLS cert fingerprint for verification. Omitted when not set.

approval_public_key.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 public key of the approver. Omitted when not set.

passkey_credential_id.description: WebAuthn credential ID. Omitted when not set.

passkey_client_data_json.description: WebAuthn clientDataJSON. Omitted when not set.

passkey_authenticator_data.description: WebAuthn authenticatorData. Omitted when not set.

passkey_signature.description: WebAuthn signature. Omitted when not set.

approval_proof._description: All fields needed to record an L3 approval. CLI Ed25519 fields are present for CLI approvals; passkey WebAuthn fields are present for all approvals going forward.

approved_by.description: CLI session ID or user ID of the approver

cli_signature.description: CLI Ed25519 signature. Omitted for passkey-only approvals.

cert_fingerprint.description: mTLS certificate fingerprint. Omitted when not set.

approval_public_key.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 public key of the approver. Omitted when not set.

credential_id.description: WebAuthn credential ID. Omitted when not set.

client_data_json.description: WebAuthn clientDataJSON. Omitted when not set.

authenticator_data.description: WebAuthn authenticatorData. Omitted when not set.

signature.description: WebAuthn signature. Omitted when not set.
